faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Bank of India Counselor-FLC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Counselor-FLC posts is 15th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor-FLC post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Proficiency in MS Office, internet, and local language typing are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Counselor-FLC position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Counselor-FLC post is between 46 years (minimum) and 64 years (maximum). There is no mention of age relaxation for any category in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Counselor-FLC role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Counselor-FLC position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 26,000, along with a conveyance allowance of Rs. 1,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor-FLC post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Counselor-FLC post in the Central Bank of India recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Central Bank of India Counselor-FLC recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Counselor-FLC posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Counselor-FLC posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Counselor-FLC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Counselor-FLC post will be based on a Personal Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Counselor-FLC position is a contract-based job. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Counselor-FLC post is Ambikapur, Chhattisgarh, with a pincode of 497001.
